claim_text: As of November 24, 2025, USAO-MN identified Abdirashid Bixi Dool, age 36, as the 78th defendant charged in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme. A charge is an allegation unless later resolved by plea, verdict, dismissal, or another court disposition.

qualifiers: This is an official DOJ ordinal milestone stated outright by the source, not a value derived by this corpus through addition, subtraction, or roster reconciliation.

Charged, convicted, and sentenced are overlapping procedural stages of the same population, not additive groups; do not sum or subtract this value against the convicted or sentenced metrics to infer a 'pending' count.
A later individual charging announcement does not by itself change this published ordinal. Only an explicit newer DOJ statement of a higher charged-count ordinal supersedes this record.
This claim covers only the Feeding Our Future investigation; it does not include Housing Stabilization Services or any other program.
